chunks: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام said to some of his companions: “When Allah grants you the undertaking of the sea, then say that which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said:
“In the Name of Allah shall be its sailing and its anchoring; indeed, my Lord is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

If the sea becomes turbulent for you, then lean on your right side and say: In the Name of Allah, be still with the tranquility of Allah, be settled with the settling of Allah, and be calm by the permission of Allah, and there is no power and no strength except by Allah.

key_terms.الْبَحْرِ: the sea; the setting of the supplication and travel
key_terms.بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ: by the permission of Allah; indicating divine leave and control
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: in the Name of Allah; the opening formula of seeking blessing and protection
key_terms.لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه: there is no power nor strength except by Allah; a declaration of reliance upon Allah
key_terms.مَجْرَاهَا: its sailing or course upon the water

ai.seo_question: What du'a should be recited when traveling by sea in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication to be recited when embarking upon the sea and another when the sea becomes turbulent. It emphasizes seeking safety, calmness, and reliance upon Allah through Qur'anic wording and devotional remembrance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1329 - Abu Ja'far (as) said to some of his companions:
"When Allah (swt) grants you the opportunity to embark on the sea, recite what Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, said:
'In the Name of Allah (swt) shall be its sailing and its anchoring; indeed, my Lord (azj) is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful' (Qur'an 11:41).
If the sea becomes turbulent for you, lean on your right side and say:
'In the Name of Allah (swt), be calm with the tranquility of Allah (swt), be settled with the settling of Allah (swt), and be at peace by the permission of Allah (swt), and there is no power nor strength except by Allah (swt).'"
